source_audit.interpretation: 175 title strings are not 175 interviews. Source URL overlap is observable; official test performance is not a fully source-independent evaluation.

original_validation_split_audit.explanation: 02/03 stratify the adapted numeric labels 0=Clear Reply, 1=Ambivalent, 2=Clear Non-Reply. sklearn sorts class values and consumes RNG class by class. Raw label strings sort in a different order, so an equal random seed produces different row indices. Numeric results 343/220/14 are applicable; raw-string 341/214/10 are not the original split.

original_hierarchy_title_split_audit.index_sha256_encoding: UTF-8 JSON integer list, no spaces, original sklearn order

qnli_audit.sampling: Map raw labels to numeric 0/1 first; groupby numeric target.sample(n=6000,random_state=42); shuffle sample(frac=1,random_state=42). Matches 04_transfer_qnli.py.
qnli_audit.note: Split-local QNLI index values may overlap and are not global document IDs. Correct one-decimal sampled lengths are 9.8/26.5, not 9.9/26.4.

cache_lr_reproduction.meaning: Fresh LR fit and prediction on the existing frozen feature cache, not a new sentence encoding or complete end-to-end rerun.

new_url_group_holdout.purpose: Post-hoc source-group sensitivity; no model selection or official-test retuning
